item.title: Kenya Selects Avalanche Blockchain to Verify Academic Records
item.summary: Kenya has introduced a blockchain-based platform for verifying academic credentials through the Kenya National Examinations Council, or KNEC, placing more than 30 million education records on the Avalanche blockchain. The initiative is intended to reduce certificate fraud and simplify the process of confirming academic qualifications.
